Name: DE-Divisions
Statement:
-- +CUSTOMFIELDS(Skill.Module.BusinessObjects.Division)
select  div.Oid,
        div.Oid as DocumentOid,
        com.Oid as CompanyId,
        com.Name as Company,
        div.Oid as DivisionId,
        div.Name as Division,
        div.ExternalId,
        div.Code
from    Division div
            join Company com on com.Oid = div.Company
